# Kapoor's Villa | Panchgani & Mahabaleshwar

> Kapoor's Villa is a boutique luxury homestay located in the Panchgani-Mahabaleshwar belt of Satara, Maharashtra.

## Location & Distance Highlights
- **Nirwana:** 2 km
- **Bhilar (Book Village):** 12 km
- **Mapro Garden:** 16 km
- **Panchgani Town:** 17 km
- **Mahabaleshwar Market:** 26 km

## Key Amenities
- Private Pool
- In-villa Dining / Menu
- Luxury Suites
- Air Conditioning
- Free Wi-Fi
- Lawn
- 24/7 Concierge
